name: Tekton Area Load
description: Pressure on a beam grid, in kN/m2 - for roofs and floors framed with beams and no plates. The fields between the horizontal members of one level take the pressure; TektonApplyLoads hands each field's load to the members around it (45-degree rule for rectangles, centroid rule otherwise). Regions are closed curves tested in plan, even-odd: outline plus inner curve is the ring between. On plates use Surface Load. On a shaped (folded) roof give 'band'; 'transfer' makes RFEM carry the load as load transfer surfaces.

inputParameters.name: regions
inputParameters.description: Closed curves; a field is loaded when its centre lies inside (even-odd, in plan). Empty = the whole level.

inputParameters.name: pressure
inputParameters.description: Area load [kN/m2]. Negative z is downward.

inputParameters.name: level
inputParameters.description: z of the beam grid (document units). Empty = the highest level.

inputParameters.name: band
inputParameters.description: Shaped roof: every near-horizontal member (rising up to 0.25 m per m) whose mid-height lies within this depth below the level (document units). Empty = one flat level.

inputParameters.name: transfer
inputParameters.description: RFEM: carry the load as load transfer surfaces (Lastuebertragungsflaechen) on the fields instead of member loads, as an engineer models it. Other backends always get the member loads.
